name: dynamic 90 90 hip twist
description: A flowing hip rotation drill that moves the hips through internal and external rotation.
instructions: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, feet wide.
Lean back a little and support yourself with your hands.
Rotate both knees to one side so they drop toward the floor.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your movements slow and controlled.
